title: Tennessee Death Row Inmate Survives Botched Lethal Injection, On Ventilator
detail: Christa Pike, a Tennessee death row inmate, survived a botched lethal injection execution and is now unconscious on a ventilator, according to her lawyers. The development marks a significant legal and humanitarian crisis following the Supreme Court's prior green-light for her execution. Legal advocates are expected to seek emergency court intervention on grounds of cruel and unusual punishment.

media.caption: Christa Pike, Tennessee death row inmate, survives botched lethal injection
